title: Hero Section Rendering and Animation
description: Verify that the Hero Section renders correctly with the animated introduction and the call-to-action button is functional.

steps.description: Load the homepage to view the Hero Section.
Check that the animated introduction text is visible and animates as expected.
Verify the call-to-action button is present and clickable.
Click the call-to-action button.
Confirm the expected navigation or action triggered by the button.

title: About Me Section Content and Responsiveness
description: Ensure the About Me Section displays the owner's personal background and adapts to various screen sizes.

steps.description: Navigate to the About Me Section.
Verify all expected personal information and background content is visible.
Resize browser window to mobile, tablet, and desktop viewports.
Confirm that the layout and text remains readable and well formatted at all sizes.

title: Skills Section 3D Particle Ring and Marquee
description: Validate that the Skills Section displays the interactive 3D particle ring and the animated marquee rows with skill logos smoothly.

steps.description: Navigate to the Skills Section.
Verify the 3D particle ring renders and interacts with user input (e.g., mouse movement).
Confirm marquee rows scroll horizontally with animated skill logos.
Interact with the particle ring elements if applicable.
Ensure interaction triggers expected animation changes or effects.
Test on different device viewports for responsiveness.
Check no frame drops or stuttering during animations.

title: Projects Section Filtering and Project Cards
description: Check that the Projects Section allows filtering and displays detailed project cards correctly.

steps.description: Navigate to the Projects Section.
Verify all project cards are visible by default.
Use the filtering controls to filter projects by category or tag.
Confirm that only projects matching the filter criteria are displayed.
Click on a project card.
Verify detailed information about the project is displayed correctly.
Apply multiple filters consecutively including boundary case of no matches.
Confirm appropriate messages for empty states and no errors.

title: Experience Section Timeline Interaction
description: Ensure the professional timeline in the Experience Section renders correctly and is navigable.

steps.description: Navigate to the Experience Section.
Verify each timeline item including internships and job history is displayed chronologically.
Scroll through the timeline vertically.
Confirm that timeline items load smoothly with any scroll-triggered animations.
Test navigation via keyboard and screen readers for accessibility.
Ensure timeline content is accessible and focus states are visible.

title: Publications Section List and Accessibility
description: Validate that academic and research publications are listed correctly and accessible.

steps.description: Navigate to the Publications Section.
Verify all publication entries are displayed with correct metadata (title, authors, date).
Check links to publication sources (if any) are functional.
Ensure screen readers can correctly read publication list items.
Test responsive layout on various devices.
Confirm no overflow or layout breaking occurs.

title: Contact Form Validation and Sanitization
description: Confirm that the contact form input fields validate user input with Zod schema and sanitize inputs to prevent security vulnerabilities.

steps.description: Navigate to the Contact Section.
Input invalid data into the form fields (e.g., invalid email format, empty required fields).
Verify validation messages appear correctly and prevent form submission.
Enter inputs with malicious scripts or code injection attempts.
Confirm sanitization removes unsafe content and no scripts execute.
Input valid data and submit the form.
Check that form submission proceeds and user is informed of success or any errors.

title: Contact Form Email Integration and End-to-End Flow
description: Test the contact form submission backend integration using Resend and Nodemailer, ensuring email delivery success and handling failures gracefully.

steps.description: Submit the contact form with valid data.
Verify that an email is sent successfully via backend services.
Confirm the user receives a success notification.
Simulate backend failure (e.g., disconnect email service).
Submit the form again.
Verify that an error message is displayed and form submission is handled gracefully without crashing.

title: Navigation Menu Sticky Behavior and Responsiveness
description: Ensure the header navigation menu sticks to the top on scroll and the responsive mobile menu works as expected.

steps.description: Load the webpage and scroll down.
Verify that the header remains visible and sticks to the top.
Resize the browser viewport to mobile size.
Check that the responsive mobile menu icon appears.
Open the mobile menu.
Confirm menu items are displayed and clickable.
Navigate using the menu links on both desktop and mobile.
Verify navigation to corresponding sections works correctly.

title: Footer Rendering and Social Links
description: Verify the footer displays all expected social media links and copyright information.

steps.description: Scroll to the bottom of any page.
Check footer contains appropriate copyright text.
Confirm all social media icons/links are present.
Click on each social media link.
Verify that each link opens the correct social profile in a new tab.

title: Custom Cursor Animation and Interaction
description: Test the animated custom cursor follows mouse movement and interacts correctly with interactive elements.

steps.description: Move the mouse cursor around the page.
Verify the custom cursor follows the pointer smoothly without lag.
Hover over interactive elements such as buttons and links.
Confirm custom cursor changes appearance as expected on hover states.

title: Smooth Page Transitions and Scroll Animations
description: Ensure page transitions and scroll-triggered animations execute smoothly and without errors.

steps.description: Navigate between different pages or major sections.
Verify smooth animated transitions powered by Framer Motion.
Scroll through pages and sections.
Check that scroll-triggered animations and parallax effects activate correctly and perform smoothly without frame drops.

title: Error Boundary Captures React Errors Gracefully
description: Test that the React Error Boundary catches JavaScript runtime errors and displays a fallback UI without crashing the whole app.

steps.description: Induce a React rendering error in a child component.
Verify the error boundary captures the error and displays a user-friendly fallback UI.
Confirm that the rest of the app remains operable and functional.

title: Lazy Loading and Optimized Images
description: Validate that images and components load lazily with loading indicators and appear correctly without layout shifting.

steps.description: Load pages containing images and lazy loaded components.
Confirm loading indicators display while content is fetching.
Verify images load lazily and appear optimized (responsive sizes, no flickering or broken images).
Simulate slow network conditions.
Ensure user experience remains acceptable with placeholders and smooth loading.

title: Performance Metrics Meet Core Web Vitals Standards
description: Ensure performance metrics such as Largest Contentful Paint, First Input Delay, and Cumulative Layout Shift meet the recommended Core Web Vitals thresholds.

steps.description: Run performance monitoring tools under typical usage.
Verify performance metrics fall within acceptable Core Web Vitals standards.
Test on multiple device types and network conditions.
Confirm consistent performance results indicating memory usage is optimized and no leaks occur.

title: Analytics Tracking for User Interactions and Scroll Depth
description: Check that custom analytics accurately captures user interactions, section views, and scroll depth data.

steps.description: Perform user interactions including section navigation, clicks on interactive components, and scrolling.
Verify that analytics events are triggered and logged correctly.
Inspect analytics data output or reports.
Confirm data reflects actual user actions without missing events.

title: Serverless API Endpoints for Contact Form Rate Limiting and Robustness
description: Test serverless API endpoints enforce rate limiting and handle failures robustly during contact form submissions.

steps.description: Submit contact form repeatedly to trigger rate limiting.
Verify that further requests are blocked or delayed with appropriate error responses.
Simulate backend errors or network failures during API calls.
Ensure the frontend shows meaningful error messages without crashing.

title: Service Worker Offline Support and Caching
description: Validate that the PWA service worker caches resources and provides offline support properly.

steps.description: Load the website once with network enabled to allow caching.
Go offline and reload the page.
Verify that cached contents load correctly even without network.
Check that new content updates when network is restored.

title: Interactive UI Components Behavior
description: Verify functionality and animation of interactive components: Like Button, Certification Card, and Skill Badge.

steps.description: Navigate to UI components on relevant sections.
Click Like Button and observe animation and state change.
Confirm Like Button toggles correctly and persists state if applicable.
Inspect Certification Card displays correct information with expected layout and any animations.
Verify Skill Badge is rendered properly with correct skill text or icons.
